name: statusline-desktop
description: Cross-platform companion with end-to-end encrypted Codex usage sync.
author: Inmerzion

scripts.format: prettier --write "src/**/*.{ts,css}" "scripts/**/*.mjs" "src-tauri/tauri*.json" "../StatuslineRelay/{src,test}/**/*.ts" "../StatuslineRelay/{package.json,tsconfig.json,vitest.config.ts,wrangler.jsonc,README.md}" "../protocol/**/*.{json,md}" ../.github/workflows/desktop-installers.yml ../.github/workflows/desktop-installer-smoke.yml ../docs/architecture/cross-platform-companion.md ../docs/relay/deployment-options.md ../docs/release/desktop-installers.md ../docs/release/public-beta-checklist.md ../PRIVACY.md ../SETUP.md ../SUPPORT.md index.html package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "src/**/*.{ts,css}" "scripts/**/*.mjs" "src-tauri/tauri*.json" "../StatuslineRelay/{src,test}/**/*.ts" "../StatuslineRelay/{package.json,tsconfig.json,vitest.config.ts,wrangler.jsonc,README.md}" "../protocol/**/*.{json,md}" ../.github/workflows/desktop-installers.yml ../.github/workflows/desktop-installer-smoke.yml ../docs/architecture/cross-platform-companion.md ../docs/relay/deployment-options.md ../docs/release/desktop-installers.md ../docs/release/public-beta-checklist.md ../PRIVACY.md ../SETUP.md ../SUPPORT.md index.html package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts README.md
scripts.release:check: npm run release:preflight && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run check
scripts.bundle:macos: tauri build --ci --target universal-apple-darwin --bundles dmg && bash scripts/package-macos-pkg.sh "src-tauri/target/universal-apple-darwin/release/bundle/dmg/Statusline Companion_${npm_package_version}_universal.dmg" src-tauri/target/universal-apple-darwin/release/bundle/pkg "$npm_package_version"
